purpose: Qualify the exact A08/A09 generator configurations and produce reproducible evidence for A10 without granting evaluator authority or creating business evidence.

evaluator_candidate_configuration.explicit_non_authority: P3 execution cannot self-promote this candidate. A10 owns any later EvaluatorAuthority determination.
evaluator_candidate_configuration.circularity_guard: A candidate evaluator cannot make its own live FAIL/HOLD result an authoritative hard falsifier of generator conformance. Reference-bank disagreement is a valid qualification falsifier; live findings require governed reference/adjudication.

deterministic_contract_conformance: B2 deterministic targets cause zero model calls and zero AIOperation/AIProposal records
B0 classify_genericity output remains internal routing assessment and never user/business evidence
B0 classify_scale exact request/context/anchor/target binding; abstention precedence; positive TRAVERSABLE requires support
live_generator_behavior: neutral/contextual rendering without new semantic authority
model unavailable/refusal/timeout yields safe fallback or hold
provider retry does not mint duplicate proposal identity
evaluator_candidate_evidence: reference-bank agreement matrix over 15 heterogeneous falsification classes
criterion-level review of real generator outputs
independence explicitly limited to different model/configuration, same provider
no authority inferred from agreement alone
Live generator-output reviews are retained as findings; they do not self-authorize the evaluator or become hard falsifiers without reference/adjudication.

execution_boundaries.source_inputs: synthetic/reference fixtures only; never user/business evidence
execution_boundaries.persistence: qualification harness must not write qualification fixtures or model outputs into eve_pr3 production evidence tables

hard_falsifiers: model call on B0.5 or B1
model call on a B2 DETERMINISTIC target
proposal promoted to EvidenceItem or captured_user_evidence without user action
retry creates second proposal for same A07 identity
technical adapter changes promoted B0/B2 semantic canon
B0 internal routing output materialized as captured_user_evidence or business truth
B0 classify_scale accepts response with mismatched request/context/anchor/target or unsupported positive TRAVERSABLE_ACTIVITY
threshold_note: Promoted sources define cases and prohibitions but do not define a statistical generalization threshold for evaluator authority. P3 therefore reports exact observations/agreement and hard falsifiers; A10 must make the authority determination from that evidence without treating presence of a score as automatic qualification.
next_gate: A10 only after real generator/evaluator-candidate execution evidence exists
execution_precondition: A08 and A09 source implementation complete; EVE_PR3_OPENAI_API_KEY must be available server-side/local execution context for real-model qualification. Absence of the credential blocks only real-model execution, not structural source conformance.
